data.name: AddIronKnightStabUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update lets the Iron Knight of Raklion attack with its stab, which the client shows with a combo effect.

data.name: AddLorenMarketRaulJewelBundlePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add Loren Market Jeweler Raul jewel bundles

data.name: AddLorenMarketRaulJewelBundlePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update lets Jeweler Raul (546) of the Loren Market open the jewel bundle window, to combine jewels into bundles and disband them, like Lahap.

data.name: MoveServerPortsOutOfDynamicRangePlugInBase_Name
data.value: Move server ports out of the dynamic port range

data.name: MoveServerPortsOutOfDynamicRangePlugInBase_Description
data.value: This update moves the ports of the game servers and the chat server from 55900 – 55999 to 45900 – 45999 (e.g. 55901 to 45901 and 55980 to 45980), because the former ports are within the dynamic port range of the operating system and may already be in use. Adjust your firewall, port forwardings and docker compose files accordingly.

data.name: FixTransformationRingRulesUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Fix transformation ring rules

data.name: FixTransformationRingRulesUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Requires character level 50 for transformation ring levels 3 to 5 and adds the Death Cow ring's 20% maximum-health bonus.

data.name: AddRageFighterAncientSetsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add Rage Fighter Ancient Sets

data.name: AddRageFighterAncientSetsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the ancient sets Vega and Chamer of the Sacred items.

data.name: ConfigureCastleSiegeGuardTalkPlugInsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Configure Castle Siege guards

data.name: ConfigureCastleSiegeGuardTalkPlugInsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: The guardsmen at the bridge of the Castle Siege map open the registration window, and the guard at the Land of Trials entrance becomes a passive NPC which opens the Land of Trials dialog.

data.name: AddItemStatProfilesUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add item stat profiles

data.name: AddItemStatProfilesUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the item stat profiles, which hold the item formulas (how requirements grow, what excellent and ancient items get more) as data, and gives each item the profile of its kind. The values the game computes stay the same; profiles which exist and items which have a profile are kept.

data.name: AddCraftingBonusPercentageAttributePlugInBase_Name
data.value: Add crafting bonus percentage attribute

data.name: AddCraftingBonusPercentageAttributePlugInBase_Description
data.value: Adds the attribute which defines the percentage points which are added to the success rate of item craftings.

data.name: FixSeedSphereMaximumItemLevelUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Fix maximum item level of seed spheres

data.name: FixSeedSphereMaximumItemLevelUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update sets the maximum item level of the seed spheres to the highest option number of their element. The item level of a seed sphere defines its option, so seed spheres with other options than the first one could not be created, e.g. with the item chat command.

data.name: AddItemPriceDefinitionsPlugIn_Name
data.value: Add item price definitions

data.name: AddItemPriceDefinitionsPlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the price definitions of special items like jewels, potions and event tickets, which were hard-coded before. Without it, these items are priced like usual equipment.

data.name: AddCrystalSwordIceChanceUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add Crystal Sword Ice Chance

data.name: AddCrystalSwordIceChanceUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the Crystal Sword ice chance, which turns an attack into an ice skill instead.

data.name: AddResetFruitsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add reset fruits

data.name: AddResetFruitsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the reset fruits of strength, agility, vitality, energy and command, which take back invested points of a stat and return them as level up points. The packages of the in-game shop which contain them are put on sale.

data.name: AddFreeTicketItemsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add free event tickets

data.name: AddFreeTicketItemsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the free tickets of Devil Square, Blood Castle, Illusion Temple and Chaos Castle, which allow to enter the event of any level. The packages of the in-game shop which contain them are put on sale.

data.name: AddGoblinBoxesUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add golden and silver boxes

data.name: AddGoblinBoxesUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the Gold Key and Silver Key, the Sealed Golden Box and Sealed Silver Box, which the keys open at the chaos goblin, and the Golden Box and Silver Box, which give an item or money when they're dropped. The packages of the in-game shop which contain the keys are put on sale.

data.name: AddKalimaTicketUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add kalima ticket

data.name: AddKalimaTicketUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the kalima ticket, which opens a gate to the level of Kalima which fits the level of the character. The packages of the in-game shop which contain it are put on sale.

data.name: AddCashShopJeweleryUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add cash shop rings and necklaces

data.name: AddCashShopJeweleryUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the Lethal Wizard's Ring, the Sapphire, Ruby, Topaz and Amethyst Rings and the Ruby, Emerald and Sapphire Necklaces of the in-game shop, with their fixed bonuses. Their packages stay not for sale, because the shop sells them for a limited time, which isn't supported yet.

data.name: AddLuckyItemsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add lucky items

data.name: AddLuckyItemsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the lucky armor sets, the lucky item tickets and the jewels of extension and elevation. David in Elveland exchanges a ticket for a lucky armor which fits the character class, and refines a lucky armor into a jewel of extension: with 60 % at full durability, with 10 % otherwise. The packages of the in-game shop which contain the tickets are put on sale.

data.name: AddBuffItemsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add buff items

data.name: AddBuffItemsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the seals, scrolls, elixirs and auras of the in-game shop, which apply a timed effect when they are used. Existing items with the same numbers are left unchanged.

data.name: AddElitePotionsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add elite potions

data.name: AddElitePotionsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the elite healing, mana and SD potions of the in-game shop, which recover health, mana or shield immediately. The packages of the in-game shop which contain them are put on sale.

data.name: AddCraftingTalismansUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add crafting talismans

data.name: AddCraftingTalismansUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the Talisman of Luck, which increases the success rate of a crafting by its durability in percent, and the Talisman of Chaos Assembly, which keeps the item of a failed +10 to +15 item upgrade. They are added to the craftings which accept them, and the packages of the in-game shop which contain them are put on sale.

data.name: FixMurenRingOfFireBonusPlugIn_Name
data.value: Fix Muren Ring of Fire Bonus

data.name: FixMurenRingOfFireBonusPlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives the Ring of Fire of the Muren ancient set its energy bonus, which was initialized as vitality.

data.name: AddSantaVillageInvitationUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add invitation to santa village

data.name: AddSantaVillageInvitationUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: This update adds the invitation to the santa village, which warps the player to the santa village, and a spawn gate to the santa village.

data.name: AddHitShockSettingsPlugIn_Name
data.value: Add hit-shock settings

data.name: AddHitShockSettingsPlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the global hit-shock chance and damage threshold settings, and the Uniria marker so Uniria-equipped players are excluded from hit shock.

data.name: FixKanturuRuins3LandingUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Fix Kanturu Ruins 3 landing area

data.name: FixKanturuRuins3LandingUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Narrows the original Kanturu Ruins 3 warp landing area to walkable terrain. Customized destinations and unrelated settings are kept.

data.name: AddSeason21MapsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the maps of the later seasons (Season 21 data)

data.name: AddSeason21MapsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the maps which were introduced after Season 6, as the Season 21 server data defines them: Acheron, Deventer, Urk Mountain, Nars, Ferea, Nixie Lake, Deep Dungeon 1-5, Swamp of Darkness, Kubera Mine 1-5, Atlans Abyss 1-3, Scorched Canyon and the later ones up to the Swamp of Destruction, with their monsters, spawns, gates and warp list entries. They require the total level (level and master level) of Season 21, so the update sets the level caps of Season 21 first. Existing data is kept. Version 5 gives Devias the 280 monsters of the Season 21 data (with the Yeti) in place of the 560 of Season 6, unless the operator changed the roster. Version 6 places the town NPCs of the Season 21 data which Season 6 lacks: Captain Slough and the maple NPCs in Noria, and Apostle Devin, Moss, Lugard and Jerint also in Lorencia. Version 7 turns on the respawn in the own safe zone of Kanturu Underground (plugin "Respawn in the map's own safe zone").

data.name: AddSeason21LevelCapsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Set the level caps of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21LevelCapsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Raises the maximum master level to 1350, as in Season 21 (400 master levels and 950 enhanced levels), and sets its master experience curve: the one of Season 6 up to master level 400, and twice its step above (a design choice: no Season 21 source gives this curve). The maximum level stays 400. A higher master level cap and a master experience formula of the operator are kept.

data.name: AddSeason21GearUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the gear of Season 21 (Season 21 data)

data.name: AddSeason21GearUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the items of Season 21 which the Season 6 character classes can use, as the Season 21 server data defines them: rings and pendants, socket weapons and shields, the blessed archangel weapons, socket armor sets, the [Bound] copies of Season 6 gear and wings, and the Wings of Conqueror. Each item takes the options and level tables of the Season 6 item of its kind. Monsters drop the items which the data lets them drop, and the red and blue chocolate boxes hold its rings. Existing items are kept.

data.name: AddSeason21ItemCatalogUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add every item of Season 21 (Season 21 data)

data.name: AddSeason21ItemCatalogUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Defines every item of the Season 21 server data which isn't defined yet, in all item groups: weapons, armor sets, wings, jewelry, pets, jewels and the other items, with their values, requirements, classes and the options of the Season 6 item of their kind. Items which a Season 6 client can't show yet (item groups 16 to 21, earrings, pentagrams, errtels, the fourth and fifth wings, muuns, timed items, quivers and seed spheres above level 5) are defined but inactive. New items don't join the random drops of the Season 6 maps; the monsters of the later maps drop them by their drop lists. Defined items are kept as they are.

data.name: ActivateSeason21WideItemsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Activate the items of the wide item format (Season 21 data)

data.name: ActivateSeason21WideItemsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Activates the items of Season 21 which only the wide item format of the Babylon client carries: the item groups 16 to 21, muuns, earrings, pentagrams, errtels, the fourth and fifth wings, timed items, quivers and the seed spheres of levels 6 to 10. A Season 6 client never gets them: not in its inventory, on the ground, in a trade, a shop or the vault, and not as the gear of other players. Monsters drop them only for a killer whose client carries them.

data.name: AddSeason21MasteryOptionsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the mastery options (Season 21 data)

data.name: AddSeason21MasteryOptionsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives the mastery weapons and armors of Season 21 their mastery option (weapons by tier, Bloodangel to Apocalypse: damage +42 to +85 and damage +1.5 to +3.0 per 20 levels; armors: health +165, mana +165, damage decrease 45, zen +45 %, defense by level) and a chance of a mastery bonus option (weapons: all stats +10/+25/+40; armors: damage decrease 25/50/75). An item with these options is shown to the Babylon client only.

data.name: AddSeason21WingGradesUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the grade options of the fourth and fifth wings (Season 21 data)

data.name: AddSeason21WingGradesUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives the fourth wings up to three of the eleven grade options of Season 21 in grades 0 to 3, and the fifth wings the same options at their fixed grade; both are wearable by the classes of their class ranks, from the fourth or fifth evolution on. Wings with grade options are shown to the Babylon client only.

data.name: AddSeason21SphereLevelsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the sphere levels 6 to 10 (Season 21 data)

data.name: AddSeason21SphereLevelsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the levels 6 to 10 to the socket options, lets the seed spheres of these levels be mounted, and adds the seed sphere enhancement of Season 21 to the seed researcher: a seed sphere of level 5 to 9, sphere upgrade runes (7 to 11) and zen give the seed sphere of the next level. Socket items with a sphere above level 5 are shown to the Babylon client only.

data.name: AddSeason21ItemMixesUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the item mixes of Season 21 (Season 21 data)

data.name: AddSeason21ItemMixesUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Turns on the item rules of Season 21 (plugin "Item rules of Season 21": the grade rates of the wings and the 2,476 mastery item mixes of S21Emu MasteryItemMix.xml) and adds to the chaos goblin: the mastery item combination (unsealing, tier upgrades, mastery jewelry; the mix is found by the items), the fourth wings combination with Garuda's feather (40 %) or with a fourth wings relic (24 %), and the wing core enhancement +1 to +15. The results of these mixes are shown to the Babylon client only. Version 2 sets the +10 to +15 combinations of the chaos machine to 60, 60, 50, 50, 40 and 40 % (S21Emu ChaosMix.dat); a rate the operator changed stays. Version 5 prices the third wings combination at 15,000,000 zen at any rate (S21Emu GoblinCombination.xml mix 39) in place of 200,000 zen per percent; a price the operator changed stays. Version 6 adds the socket upgrade of S21Emu SocketSystemCombinationMixUpgrade.xml: a socket item +11 to +15 with two or more empty sockets, a Socket Upgrade Note, 5 Bless, 5 Soul and a Chaos give the next socket item, 80 %, 10,000,000 zen.

data.name: AddSeason21EventRulesUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Set the event grades and party bonus of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21EventRulesUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives Blood Castle, Devil Square and Chaos Castle the seven grades of Season 21 and Illusion Temple its five, all by total level (level and master level) and the same for every class; the eighth Blood Castle and the sixth Illusion Temple close. Sets the party experience bonus of Season 21: 1.0 to 3.2 by party size, 1.5 to 6.4 for a party of at least three classes. Grades which an operator already moved above the level cap are kept. Version 2 sets the daily entry limits of the data (15 a day for Blood Castle, Chaos Castle, Devil Square, Doppelganger, Imperial Guardian, Illusion Temple and the Boss Battle, 10 for the Labyrinth), unless the operator set limits.

data.name: FixZombieFighterHealthUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Fix the health of the Zombie Fighter of Vulcanus

data.name: FixZombieFighterHealthUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Corrects the maximum health of the Zombie Fighter (481) of Vulcanus from 5,000,000 to 500,000, like its siblings. A value an operator changed is kept.

data.name: FixKundunUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Fix Kundun of Kalima 7

data.name: FixKundunUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives Kundun (275), the boss of Kalima 7, its own numbers (level 147, 5,000,000 health, 12 hours respawn) instead of a copy of the Illusion of Kundun of Kalima 6. A value an operator changed is kept.

data.name: AddProgressionUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Turn on the progression of the Season 21 maps (stars)

data.name: AddProgressionUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Turns on the progression of the Season 21 maps in the stars mode: map requirements and monsters normalized into level 400, stars (resets) above the first band, master levels off. In the stars mode it also turns on the reset feature with the star costs (10 stars, level 400, 5,000,000 zen times the star, Jewels of Life from star 6); values an operator changed are kept. Version 2 fills the Season 21 levels of the classic warps and gates (used in the original mode, and in the others when the classic entry levels setting asks for them), unless the operator filled them. The mode and every number are settings of the progression plugin; the Season 21 rows stay unchanged.

data.name: AddSeason21ClassesUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the classes of Season 21 (Season 21 data)

data.name: AddSeason21ClassesUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the fourth and fifth evolution of the seven Season 6 classes and the nine classes of Season 21 (Grow Lancer, Rune Wizard, Slayer, Gun Crusher, Light Wizard, Lemuria Mage, Illusion Knight, Alchemist, Crusader) with all their evolutions, as the Season 21 server data defines their base stats, health, mana and stat formulas (version 2 sets the formulas of the nine classes again; version 3 adds their skill damage rates, the shield recovery point and the ability recovery of the Season 21 calculation). A new fourth or fifth evolution may use the items and skills of the evolution before it. Only clients of the Season 21 protocol can create and show the new classes; a Season 6 client sees a fourth or fifth evolution as the third one. Existing classes are kept.

data.name: AddSeason21SkillsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the skills of Season 21 (Season 21 data)

data.name: AddSeason21SkillsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the skills of the nine classes of Season 21 and the fourth and fifth evolution skills of the Season 6 classes, as the Season 21 server data defines them (damage, mana, AG, range, requirements, classes), the master tree nodes Season 21 adds, the books which teach them and the skill enhancement tree of the fourth evolution. Skills whose effects the server can't simulate yet are kept as data. Skills with a damage rate of their own in the Season 21 calculation get it (version 2). The passives of the tree which raise an attribute (maximum health, physical, wizardry and curse damage, skill damage) apply it by their level (version 4). Existing skills keep their values; they only get the new classes. Requires the classes and the items of Season 21.

data.name: AddSeason21InitialSkillsPlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the first skills of the Season 21 classes

data.name: AddSeason21InitialSkillsPlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the skills a new character of a Season 21 class starts with (Clash, Magical Shot, Mana Glaive, ...).

data.name: AddSeason21EvolutionQuestsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the evolution quests of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21EvolutionQuestsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the 4th and 5th class quests: Sent in Lorencia and Eunice in Devias, the Trial Area (map 121) with Sent and Eunice and the trial monsters, and the three quests of each evolution for every class, ending in the evolution. Needs the maps, the classes and the items of Season 21.

data.name: AddSeason21EliteZonesUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the elite zones of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21EliteZonesUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Places the elites of the later maps in the five elemental elite zones at Webzen's entrances (Twisted Karutan's walled zones opened as the Season 21 client has them), adds the elites of Ignis, Kardamahal and Swamp of Doom, and turns on the elite zones plugin.

data.name: AddSeason21FieldBossesUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the field bosses of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21FieldBossesUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds Medusa, Lord of Ferea with its crystal orb and the God of Darkness with its stages, the item bags of the bosses, and turns on the field bosses plugin with the shared 18 to 24 hour respawn. Lord Silvester and Core Magriffy no longer spawn as plain monsters.

data.name: AddSeason21EconomyUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the gremory case, Ruud and the Ruud shop of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21EconomyUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Places Priest James (Ruud shop) in Elbeland and Loren Market, fills the Ruud shop with the items of Season 21 and the Ruud of monsters and Ruud boxes, and switches on the gremory case, Ruud and the item expiry. The jewels drop up to monster level 150 only (a jewel with a maximum drop level keeps it). Optional; a world without it stays Season 6.

data.name: AddSeason21ShopsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Set the shops of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21ShopsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Replaces the items of the merchants with the shops of Season 21, with up to five tabs. Clients before Season 21 only show the first tab. Overwrites changed merchant stores of these NPCs. Version 2 adds Wizard Gillard, whose shop the data has, as a merchant in Lorencia.

data.name: AddSeason21RewardsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the level rewards and event contribution boxes of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21RewardsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Configures the level rewards (a Muun at every 50 total levels from 950 to 1750) and the event contribution points with the Mastery Boxes of Season 21, which land in the gremory case, and switches both on. Optional.

data.name: AddSeason21ElementsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the elements, pentagrams and errtels (Season 21 data)

data.name: AddSeason21ElementsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives the pentagrams of Season 21 the pentagram slot (236), a random element, up to five sockets and their elemental damage, defense and rates; gives the errtels an element and their rank options (rank 1 when they drop); adds the elemental attack and defense of every monster of the Season 21 data and the elemental stats of every class (version 3), the element imprints of the skills and the errtel removal rates, and turns on the elements feature. Pentagrams and errtels are shown to the Babylon client only.

data.name: AddSeason21EarringsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the earrings (Season 21 data)

data.name: AddSeason21EarringsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Gives the earrings of Season 21 their slots (right 237, left 238), their base stats, one to three random options and the link options of a left and right earring of the same tier (enemy defense ignore, all stats). Earrings are shown to the Babylon client only.

data.name: AddSeason21MuunsUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the Muuns of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21MuunsUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Configures the Muun system of Season 21 (386 Muuns, their options and additional options, the energy converter, six exchange offers), adds the evolution target to the evolution stones and places Monica, the exchange NPC, in Elbeland; switches the Muun system on. A configuration with Muuns stays. Optional.

data.name: AddSeason21MiningUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the mining of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21MiningUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the mining spots of Season 21 (small, medium, large) to the safe zones of Lost Tower, Tarkan, Aida, Swamp of Calmness, Raklion and Kubera Mine, sells the Pandora Pick of Bolo at its full durability and turns the mining on, with the stages of the Season 21 data.

data.name: AddSeason21GoldenInvasionUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the golden, Underworld and Summon invasions of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21GoldenInvasionUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Adds the ten later golden monsters (Golden Dark Knight, Devil, Stone Golem, Crust, Satyros, Twin Tail, Iron Knight, Napin, Great Golden Dragon, Golden Rabbit) with their Box of Kundun and the Golden Derkon in Elbeland to the golden invasion. A golden invasion with the Season 6 roster gets the roster and timetable of Season 21 (every four hours from 00:25, 10 minutes); one you changed keeps your numbers and only gets the missing monsters and maps. Version 2 adds the Underworld invasion (the Death King with 110 Death Bones on Lorencia or Noria) and the Summon invasion (Golden Goblins on Tarkan, Aida, Kanturu, Karutan or Acheron) and switches them on.

data.name: AddSeason21HuntingRecordUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the hunting record of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21HuntingRecordUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Sets the 59 hunting maps and the excluded event monsters of the Season 21 hunting record and turns the hunting record and the ranking on. A configuration with maps stays. Optional.

data.name: AddSeason21SoulConverterUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the monster soul converter of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21SoulConverterUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Sets the five tiers of the Season 21 monster soul converter (items 14/460-464, total level 400 to 1450, two soul missions each, the reward bags of Ruud, jewels, elemental options and accessories) and turns the converter on. A configuration with tiers stays. Optional.

data.name: AddSeason21HelperPlusUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the MU Helper Plus of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21HelperPlusUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Sets the 31 hunting grounds (with their warps) and the 330 hunting zones of the Season 21 MU Helper Plus and turns it on. A configuration with zones stays. Optional; needs the maps of the later seasons.

data.name: AddSeason21InstancesUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the party instances of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21InstancesUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Turns the trial of the fourth and fifth class quest into a copy of the Trial Area for each party (Season 21 instance system). Needs the evolution quests of Season 21.

data.name: AddSeason21DoppelgangerUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Renew the Doppelganger for Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21DoppelgangerUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Seven rooms by total level (50, 400, 800, 900, 1100, 1300, 1500) with the monster multipliers, experience and silver and golden chests of Season 21; every level from 50 may enter, a game needs two players. Replaces the monster scaling of the Doppelganger.

data.name: AddSeason21TormentedSquareUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the Tormented Square of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21TormentedSquareUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Map 102 with the Tormented Square: fifteen rounds of monsters with golden bonus monsters, points per kill and per cleared round, ranks; switches its timetable on (11:44, 17:30, 19:00, 20:30, 22:00, 23:30).

data.name: AddSeason21InstanceZoneUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the Instance Zone and the Labyrinth of Dimensions of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21InstanceZoneUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Map 114 with Cent, Eunice, Jerint and the Portal of Dimension; the town NPCs of the fourth and fifth class quests take a character there, Cent and Eunice into the trial instance of its party. Map 115 with the Labyrinth of Dimensions, a solo instance of 41 floors with Ruud and boxes.

data.name: AddSeason21BossBattleUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the Boss Battle Together of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21BossBattleUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Map 139 with the Boss Battle Together: up to 100 players from total level 800 for 10,000,000 zen fight one of five bosses (80,000,000 health, more for more players) for 5 minutes; 1,000,000 damage, the top damage and the last hit give their boxes, into the gremory case when it's on. Switches its timetable on (00:05).

data.name: AddSeason21AcheronGuardianUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the Protector of Acheron of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21AcheronGuardianUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: The event copies of Acheron (map 92) and Deventer (map 96) with the Protector of Acheron: from total level 450, 30 waves of the area monsters for 30 minutes, an item of the Protection of Acheron bag for 100 points. Switches its timetable on (4:29, 12:00, 23:06).

data.name: AddSeason21ImperialGuardianReworkUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Apply the Imperial Guardian rework of Season 18

data.name: AddSeason21ImperialGuardianReworkUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Every day of the Imperial Guardian from total level 1000 (Season 21 data), and at its completion four or two Artifact Upgrade Stones or a Spider Artifact Fragment (20 / 40 / 40 %), into the gremory case when it's on. Keeps rewards the operator set.

data.name: AddSeason21CrywolfUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Apply the Crywolf renewal of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21CrywolfUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Crywolf of Season 21 Part 1 Update 3: the army takes the element of the week (fire, water, earth, wind, darkness, changing on Thursday 00:00), Balgass appears 6:40 into the battle and is immune to debuffs, the rewards go into the gremory case, the altars open on Monday 9:30, and the state durations of the Season 21 data. Keeps a renewal and a schedule the operator set.

data.name: AddSeason21SeasonPassUpdatePlugIn_Name
data.value: Add the season pass of Season 21

data.name: AddSeason21SeasonPassUpdatePlugIn_Description
data.value: Sets the season pass (MU Pass) of Season 21: the monthly schedule (repeated every year), 20 levels, 25 daily and one special mission (their kind is yours to set), the rewards of the free and gold pass and the buffs, and turns it on. A configuration with seasons stays. Optional; needs the item catalog.

data.name: AddSeason21LabyrinthLeagueUpdatePlugIn_Name
